description: Enforce that the brainstorming skill never modifies its own files

hooks.command: bash -lc 'g="${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-$PWD}}}}/hooks/guard-self-edit.py"; [ -f "$g" ] || exit 0; command -v python3 >/dev/null || exit 0; python3 "$g"; if [ $? -eq 2 ]; then exit 2; fi; exit 0'
hooks.commandWindows: $root = @($env:CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT, $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT, $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, $env:PLUGIN_ROOT, $PWD.Path) | Where-Object { $_ } | Select-Object -First 1; $g = Join-Path $root 'hooks/guard-self-edit.py'; if (-not (Test-Path $g)) { exit 0 }; if (-not (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { exit 0 }; python $g; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 2) { exit 2 } else { exit 0 }
hooks.powershell: $root = @($env:CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT, $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT, $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, $env:PLUGIN_ROOT, $PWD.Path) | Where-Object { $_ } | Select-Object -First 1; $g = Join-Path $root 'hooks/guard-self-edit.py'; if (-not (Test-Path $g)) { exit 0 }; if (-not (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { exit 0 }; python $g; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 2) { exit 2 } else { exit 0 }
